g.text: 🎯 Open to Off-Campus SDE / Backend / GenAI roles
Interactive simulation of multi-tenant RAG event loop & RLS

g.title: Client: Authenticated with tenant-scoped JWT bearer
FastAPI Gateway: Injects tenant context & enforces RLS session
Kafka / Redpanda: Transactional outbox event streaming with DLQs
Worker Pool: Parses documents, generates embeddings & evals
PostgreSQL + pgvector: Hardened with forced RLS and HNSW indexing
